title: A Decent Looking Bed, A Few Disappointments
text:
A Decent Looking Bed, A Few Disappointments. I really like the looks of this bed if you squint a little and look at it from a ways off. I have owned a couple of very nice wrought iron beds and really liked the looks but they were higher quality than this one. I got a couple disappointments when I put it together. The biggest of which is that my rigid box spring could not fit the bed lengthwise. I ended up having to shift box springs around to get one that would fit the bed.

Set up was quick and easy. I'm not sure why this is called a snap bed, or why the video advertisement says the pieces snap into place. There is nothing that snaps, but it is an easy construction. 8 screws with the needed allen wrench included is nice. The pieces fit together fine, and while this is not the sturdiest bed I've owned, it is as good as most inexpensive head and foot boards that attach to a bed frame.

The finish is a painted on fake brushed nickel. There were two voids in the paint on mine and the threat that it can be scratched off. The welds are large and rough, perhaps that was a look they were going for, but they are amateurish enough to look less elegant. All in all, it's an OK bed, just not as good as I would have hoped from the photos and video.

product_metadata.title: Leggett & Platt Fremont Metal SNAP Bed with Folding Frame Bedding Support System and Rounded Edge Panels, Weathered Nickel Finish, King
features: Finish: Silver brushed, Weathered Nickel finish
Narrow all-in-one-box easy to maneuver through small hallways and staircases
description: The Fremont SNAP™ Bed solves the problem of having to sacrifice fashion and style in the bedroom due to difficult assembly, oversized components or costly expenses. This transitional style bed has rounded edges that frame clean, straight lines throughout the 48-inch headboard and 19-inch footboard. Constructed of carbon steel for strength and stability, the frame has a brushed silver, Weathered Nickel finish with castings to provide extra detail in this bed design. This fashion forward bed is not only contemporary with its folding frame, built-in bedding support system, all-in-one-box design, but compact enough for standard shipping methods and retail store “carry-out” portability. The narrow SNAP™ Bed box is easy to maneuver through small hallways and staircases and includes everything included to make assembly a breeze. The easy-to-assemble steps can be summed up to 1) Assemble the headboard posts and pillow bar. 2) Unfold the side rails and snap them into the headboard and footboard. 3) Tighten the six (6) support legs into the slats. 4) Snap the slats into the side rails. Within minutes you’ll be ready to enjoy your new stylish bed. A box spring is required for this bed. This unit includes a headboard, footboard, folding side rails, bed support system, Allen wrench and minimal hardware for quick and easy assembly. The Leggett & Platt Fremont SNAP™ Bed comes with a 1-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Leggett & Platt Inc. is an industry leader in the production of adjustable bases, fashionable beds, bedding support, and top of bed textiles. By keeping a close eye on the design community and other fashion and decorating sources, Leggett & Platt stays on top of the trends and knows the right mix of finishes, innovative designs, and technology to continually provide quality crafted products at an exceptional value. Leggett & Platt Consumer Products: Value Without Compromise
